title: RoomDesignInput
description: The room design every Empathia room engine consumes (classification, design checks, commissioning applicability). Mirrors the TypeScript interface RoomDesignInput in packages/domain-types/src/room.ts, which keeps the 2.5.4 demonstrator's field names (src/v25-60-room.js). Units: metres and degrees. Synthetic data only in this repository.

template.description: huddle | small_conf | medium_conf | boardroom | executive | training | townhall | auditorium | studio | collab | open_office | private_office | lobby | idf | custom (V25_ROOM_TEMPLATES)

occupancy.description: people; the engine accepts 0 (demonstrator golden cases include 0-occupancy rooms); the API requires 1–5000 when a room is created or edited

lifecycle.description: PLANNED | DESIGN_APPROVED | INSTALLATION_PENDING | INSTALLED_UNVERIFIED | COMMISSIONING | ACCEPTED | OPERATIONAL (ROOM_LIFECYCLE); other strings are tolerated by the type for demonstrator imports

results.description: by test id; only on an installed room in COMMISSIONING or later

Provenance.description: DECLARED | MODELED | PHOTO_INFERRED | SCALED_PLAN (PHOTO_INFERRED is never a known fact for applicability); the API also records UNREADABLE for a refused input

points.description: outline, first point not repeated; accepted by polygonCheck: extent 0.5–200 m per axis, no self-intersection, area ≥ 2 m²

ceiling.description: metres; the API accepts more than 1.8 and less than 30 at creation

provenance.description: per dimension: length, width, ceiling (and outline when drawn)

id.description: canonical planned-asset id (PA-0001 in the API); never changes on substitution

cat.description: equipment category (V25_ROOM_CATS): display, ledwall, projector, camera, bar, micceil, mictable, micwireless, speaker, dsp, amp, compute, switch, control, touch, scheduler, switcher, encoder, rack, pdu, lighting, occsensor, seccam, iot, hvac, table, chairs, lectern

model.description: 'generic' for a generic sample object, else a synthetic catalogue key

brand.description: always null for generic objects; the repository's catalogue is synthetic

z.description: metres above the floor (category default when absent)

furniture.description: furniture is drawn but excluded from the relationship graph and the device count

state.description: what was recorded; the displayed label is derived: PASS → PASS_UNVERIFIED until verified by a different person → PASS_VERIFIED
